namespace = patent_events

patent_events.300 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = patent_events.1.t
	desc = patent_events.1.d
	flavor = patent_events.1.f
	event_image = { video = "unspecific_gears_pistons" }
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"
	duration = 3
	option = {
		name = patent_events.1.a
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = patent_events.1.a.tt
		hidden_effect = {
			save_scope_as = patent_holder
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_country_alive = yes
					NOT = { this = ROOT }
					NOT = { has_technology_researched = sericulture }
					can_research = sericulture
				}
				trigger_event = { id = patent_events.100 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 50 }
	}
	option = { name = patent_events.1.b ai_chance = { base = 50 } }
}

patent_events.100 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = ROOT
	title = patent_events.2.t
	desc = patent_events.2.d
	flavor = patent_events.2.f
	event_image = { video = "unspecific_signed_contract" }
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"
	duration = 3
	trigger = {
		is_country_alive = yes
		NOT = { has_technology_researched = sericulture }
		can_research = sericulture
		scope:patent_holder = { is_country_alive = yes }
	}
	option = {
		name = patent_events.2.license_10
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = patent_events.2.license_10.tt
		trigger = {
            OR = {
                has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_10 }
                NOR = {
                    has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_10 }
                    has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_20 }
                    has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_30 }
                }
            }
			NOT = { has_technology_researched = sericulture }
			can_research = sericulture
			scope:patent_holder = { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_technology_researched = sericulture }
					can_research = sericulture
					scope:patent_holder = { is_country_alive = yes }
				}
				add_technology_progress = { progress = 750 technology = sericulture }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_10 } } }
					create_diplomatic_pact = { country = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_10 }
				}
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
	}
	option = {
		name = patent_events.2.license_20
		custom_tooltip = patent_events.2.license_20.tt
		trigger = {
            OR = {
                has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_20 }
                NOR = {
                    has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_10 }
                    has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_20 }
                    has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_30 }
                }
            }
			NOT = { has_technology_researched = sericulture }
			can_research = sericulture
			scope:patent_holder = { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_technology_researched = sericulture }
					can_research = sericulture
					scope:patent_holder = { is_country_alive = yes }
				}
				add_technology_progress = { progress = 1500 technology = sericulture }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_20 } } }
					create_diplomatic_pact = { country = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_20 }
				}
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 12 }
	}
	option = {
		name = patent_events.2.license_30
		custom_tooltip = patent_events.2.license_30.tt
		trigger = {
            OR = {
                has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_30 }
                NOR = {
                    has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_10 }
                    has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_20 }
                    has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_30 }
                }
            }
			NOT = { has_technology_researched = sericulture }
			can_research = sericulture
			scope:patent_holder = { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_technology_researched = sericulture }
					can_research = sericulture
					scope:patent_holder = { is_country_alive = yes }
				}
				add_technology_progress = { progress = 2250 technology = sericulture }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_30 } } }
					create_diplomatic_pact = { country = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_30 }
				}
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 3 }
	}
	option = { name = patent_events.2.b ai_chance = { base = 90 } }
}

	title = patent_events.2.t
	desc = patent_events.2.d
	flavor = patent_events.2.f
	event_image = { video = "unspecific_signed_contract" }
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"
	duration = 3
	trigger = {
		is_country_alive = yes
		NOT = { has_technology_researched = tech_bureaucracy }
		can_research = tech_bureaucracy
		has_technology_researched = urbanization
		scope:patent_holder = { is_country_alive = yes }
	}
	option = {
		name = patent_events.2.license_10
		default_option = yes
		custom_tooltip = patent_events.2.license_10.tt
		trigger = {
            OR = {
                has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_10 }
                NOR = {
                    has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_10 }
                    has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_20 }
                    has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_30 }
                }
            }
			NOT = { has_technology_researched = tech_bureaucracy }
			can_research = tech_bureaucracy
			has_technology_researched = urbanization
			scope:patent_holder = { is_country_alive = yes }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_technology_researched = tech_bureaucracy }
					can_research = tech_bureaucracy
					has_technology_researched = urbanization
					scope:patent_holder = { is_country_alive = yes }
				}
				add_technology_progress = { progress = 750 technology = tech_bureaucracy }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_10 } } }
					create_diplomatic_pact = { country = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_10 }
				}
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
	}
	option = {
		name = patent_events.2.license_20
		custom_tooltip = patent_events.2.license_20.tt
		trigger = {
            OR = {
                has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_20 }
                NOR = {
                    has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_10 }
                    has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_20 }
                    has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_30 }
                }

			can_research = tech_bureaucracy
			has_technology_researched = urbanization
			scope:patent_holder = { is_country_alive = yes }

					scope:patent_holder = { is_country_alive = yes }

				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_diplomatic_pact = { who = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_20 } } }
					create_diplomatic_pact = { country = scope:patent_holder type = patent_royalties_20 }
				}
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 12 }
	}
	option = {

		custom_tooltip = patent_events.2.license_30.tt
		trigger = {

			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 50 }
	}
	option = { name = patent_events.1.b ai_chance = { base = 50 } }
